_what_this_is: Machine-checkable architectural boundaries, read by check D12 in scripts/check-docs.mjs. A boundary is a decision an ADR made about what may depend on what, written so the audit enforces it instead of trusting somebody to remember. Registry plane: changing it requires an ADR and human approval (RULE-01).
_todo_project: Ships empty. D12 checks nothing and says so while boundaries is []. Add one entry per ADR that names an observable revert condition of the form: this package must not enter the dependency tree, or must only be reachable from this directory.

_entry_shape.id: short slug, printed in the finding
_entry_shape.adr: ADR-nnn that decided this, cited in every finding so a reader can go and read the reasoning
_entry_shape.package_prefix: package scope or prefix that is watched, for example @vendor/
_entry_shape.allowed_packages: array; the only packages under that prefix permitted in the manifest. [] forbids all of them.
_entry_shape.manifest: path to the dependency manifest to read, default package.json
_entry_shape.lint_config: path to the lint config that must name package_prefix once such a package is in the tree; omit to skip that branch
_entry_shape.source_roots: array of directories scanned for imports of package_prefix
_entry_shape.exempt_dirs: array; the only directories under source_roots permitted to import it
_entry_shape.forbidden_exemption_substring: a path fragment that must never appear in a lint exemption alongside the vendor name, typically the data seam
_entry_shape.reason: one sentence, printed in the finding, saying what breaks when the boundary is crossed
